name: Obed-Edom
title: Guardian of the Ark of the Covenant
summary: Obed-Edom was a Gittite (from Gath) in whose house the Ark of the Covenant was kept for three months after Uzzah died by touching it. The Lord blessed Obed-Edom and all his household while the ark was with him. Later, he and his descendants were appointed as gatekeepers and musicians in temple service under David.

keyEvents.title: The Death of Uzzah and the Placement of the Ark with Obed-Edom
keyEvents.description: After Uzzah died because he touched the ark, David was afraid and did not want to bring the ark to the City of David. Instead, the ark was placed in the house of Obed-Edom.

keyEvents.title: God's Blessing on the House of Obed-Edom
keyEvents.description: During the three months that the Ark of the Covenant was in the house of Obed-Edom, the Lord blessed him and all he owned. This blessing became so evident that it was reported to King David.

keyEvents.title: The Ark Moved from the House of Obed-Edom to Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: When David heard about the blessing on Obed-Edom's household, he brought the ark and led it with joy up to the City of David with sacrifices and dancing.

keyEvents.title: Obed-Edom is appointed as gatekeeper for the ark
keyEvents.description: After the ark was placed in the tent in Jerusalem, Obed-Edom and his relatives were appointed by David to serve as gatekeepers at the ark of the covenant.

keyEvents.title: Obed-Edom's sons in temple service
keyEvents.description: Obed-Edom's descendants were blessed with many sons who served as skilled gatekeepers at God's house, which was seen as a continuation of God's blessing over the family.

keyEvents.title: Obed-Edom as keeper of the temple treasures
keyEvents.description: During King Joash of Judah, it is mentioned that the gold objects under the care of Obed-Edom's descendants in the temple were taken as war booty.
